newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates soar; funds stream into stocks.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates soar; funds stream into stocks.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates soared at mid-session on Thursday with funds streaming out of the banking system into the recently red hot stock market, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 7.162 percent against Wednesday's 6.817 percent finish -- well above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper soaring to 7.00-7.25 percent against 6.75-7.00.
The stock market, despite closing lower for the first time in five sessions on Thursday, notched an all-time high turnover of T$251 billion.
Dealers said they expected the rates to stabilise later in the session, but saw little immediate room for a downward correction.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8350-8360 percent against 5.8470.
